topics.title: Challenges for the new nation-state
topics.ncert_sections: Challenges for the new nation-state; Three Challenges

concepts.learning_objective: Describe the circumstances in which India became independent and the two goals shared by the national movement.

topics.ncert_sections: Partition: displacement and rehabilitation; Process of partition

concepts.learning_objective: Explain the two-nation theory and the opposition to it.

topics.ncert_sections: Consequences of partition; Mahatma Gandhi's sacrifice

concepts.learning_objective: Describe the human, administrative and emotional consequences of partition.

concepts.learning_objective: Explain how the lapse of British paramountcy created the problem of the princely states.

concepts.learning_objective: Trace the events that led to Hyderabad's accession to India.

topics.ncert_sections: Fast Forward: Creation of new states

concepts.learning_objective: Recall the creation of states after 1956 such as Maharashtra, Gujarat, Punjab and the north-eastern states.
